title: A Jumpstart at Careers in Public Service!
description:
Giving young people a jumpstart at careers in public service! 🌟Our successful Employ & Empower internship program has been renewed for another year.

Mayor Todd Gloria signed a resolution to extend the fully state-funded program, which first launched in July 2022. Employ & Empower has already given more than 1,400 young San Diegans a pathway to a career in public service, and 15% of participants now have permanent jobs at the City. 

Employ & Empower will continue to be funded by Youth Services Corps, a statewide program within the Office of the Governor’s California Volunteers and will have no impact on the current or projected City budget for next year.

Check out sandiego.gov/Employ-Empower/About to learn more and find out how to apply!
